title: Background Story of the Invention of Efficient Blue InGaN Light Emitting Diodes
lineage: Nakamura describes Nichia’s 1993 announcement of candela-class blue InGaN LEDs and earlier GaN research. This concerns the blue emitter; a white phosphor lighting system is a distinct later system.
